coverage_questions: The paper does not document the exact tokenizers, token sequences, special tokens, positional encodings, masks, or placement rules received by GPT-4, GPT-4o, Mixtral 8x7b, or Mistral 7B.
The paper does not establish the exact prompt serialization or tokenization of metadata, gene lists, GSVA gene sets, few-shot examples, simple chats, generated conversations, or hidden chat prompts.

The paper documents GPT-4 and GPT-4o as auxiliary LLMs for curation, query generation, conversation generation, and cluster-description condensation; their internal model input transformations remain opaque.
The paper documents four developmental-stage query branches but does not state whether their annotation sentences were submitted independently or jointly beyond the stage-specific query outputs.
The paper does not document the exact Mistral placement of adapter embeddings relative to question or multi-turn conversation tokens, nor the complete attention and loss-mask construction.
The paper documents the hybrid top-gene prompt in addition to the transcriptome embedding, but does not establish the multimodal fusion algebra or placement.
The paper gives Mixtral metadata-generation sampling settings, but does not state whether the same settings were used for Mixtral-generated conversational training examples.

evidence.quote: We generated a training dataset of 106,610 conversations including simple rule-based question-answer pairs (for example, 'What does the sample represent?', with the sample's textual annotation as the designated answer) and more complex LLM-generated conversations about transcriptomes and cells (technical details are provided in the Methods, examples in Supplementary Note 2). We used the embeddings together with the training-set questions as input to the Mistral 7B LLM (with an adapter layer that converts the embeddings into Mistral-compatible token-level embeddings) and fine-tuned this LLM to produce the matched answers.

In a first training step, we kept the LLM frozen and trained the adapter layers with supervision on an extended version of the simple chats that included our entire training dataset (1,082,213 question-answer pairs) for one epoch. In a second training step, we unfroze the Mistral LLM and fine-tuned both the LLM and the adapter layers on the 106,610 generated training conversations for one epoch.

evidence.quote: Conversational chats for 81,610 transcriptomes were generated using an LLM (Mixtral 8x7b) with a few-shot prompt that instructed a natural conversation with multiple questions and answers between a researcher and an AI assistant about the biological state of the corresponding sample or cell cluster.

For each of these subsampled transcriptome-text pairs, we generated a chat-like conversation using one of two LLMs (GPT-4 or Mixtral) on the basis of (1) the transcriptome's top 50 most highly expressed genes (based on normalized expression across all transcriptomes in the dataset to improve the representation of lowly expressed but important genes such as certain transcription factors); (2) the top 50 GSVA-derived gene sets; and (3) the transcriptome's textual annotation.
